plugins.name: devplan
plugins.description: Product intelligence for software teams, powered by your Devplan workspace. Six dashboards refreshed every weekday: Daily Radar, Execution Monitoring, Demand Report with suggested projects and market trends, Stale Commitments, a searchable Changelog, and Engineering Analytics. Plan cycles from your team's real pace, and write specs that are tracked in Devplan automatically. Requires a Devplan account; setup walks you through creating one.
